mapper.select: SELECT s.in_id, s.tank_id, tk.tank_name, tk.fuel_type, s.in_volume, s.buy_price, s.vendor_name, s.in_date, s.memo, s.input_type, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM tb_stock_in s JOIN tb_tank tk ON s.tank_id = tk.tank_id WHERE s.tank_id = #{tankId} ORDER BY s.in_date ASC, s.in_id ASC

SELECT s.in_id, s.tank_id, tk.tank_name, tk.fuel_type, s.in_volume, s.buy_price, s.vendor_name, s.in_date, s.memo, s.input_type, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM tb_stock_in s JOIN tb_tank tk ON s.tank_id = tk.tank_id WHERE s.in_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY s.in_date ASC, s.in_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_stock_in (tank_id, in_volume, buy_price, vendor_name, in_date, memo, input_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tankId}, #{inVolume}, #{buyPrice}, #{vendorName}, #{inDate}, #{memo}, #{inputType}, NOW(), NOW())
